text:
Maya: FYI finance sweep flagged ~ $18,200 of unallocated GPU spend for Feb. Looks like a bunch of long-running dev instances dropped `cost_center` tags after a rollout.
Leo: ouch. any clusters/regions concentrated?
Maya: mostly us-west1 and a little in eu-west1. I uploaded the filtered billing export to GCS: gs://billing-exports/2027-02/gpu_unallocated.csv
Priya: can you paste a quick sample of the rows? need to see project ids
Maya: sample: `project_id=redwood-staging-ml,instance=dev-bert-02,gpu_hours=450,cost=5,400` and `project_id=team-algo-sandbox,instance=explore-1,gpu_hours=320,cost=3,800`. Looks like tagging rollback after the infra agent update on 2027-02-11.
Samir: hmm infra agent v2.4 had a bug where tag sync skipped instances with >30d uptime. I flagged it in eng-infra.
CostBot: Automated alert: Unallocated GPU spend > $10k in billing period. Alert id: CB-2027-02-1832509.
Leo: proposed next steps: 1) run a backfill to reattach cost_center where cloud metadata exists, 2) assign owners for any ambiguous projects, 3) create daily alert until backfill complete.
Maya: agree. I can do (1) with the backfill script. Need approvals to reclassify historical charges to teams because some customers are involved.
Priya: which customers? I can confirm landlord/customer mappings. If we can map by project_name prefix we should be safe.
Maya: two customer-linked projects: `acme-embeddings-test` and `mira-inc-poc`. Each ~ $2.5k. Finance needs explicit sign-off before reallocation.
Samir: tagging fix is merged but not deployed to older instances. I'll schedule a one-off rollout targeted at instances with uptime >30d and run the tag sync. ETA 3 hours.
Leo: Maya, Priya — can you confirm owners for the remaining unallocated projects by EOD? I'll add a temporary alert rule (threshold $2k/day unallocated) and mute after backfill.
Maya: will do. tagging backfill + owner confirmations on my side. I'll post the backfill run log here when finished. :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll validate customer mappings and DM legal for reallocation approvals where needed.
Samir: rolling out revert + targeted sync now. pinging here when done.
Maya: Thanks — please also add a note to the billing playbook about the agent edge-case so it doesn't recur.
Leo: good call. I'll update the finance runbook with playbook link + alert thresholds.
CostBot: Update: CB-2027-02-1832509 status -> acknowledged by Samir.
Maya: last note — if anyone sees recurring unallocated spend after backfill, escalate to the cost-ops rotation.
Samir: backfill complete. pushed tags to 98% of affected instances, requeued remaining 2% for manual inspection. backfill log: gs://infra-logs/tag-backfill/2027-02-11-1834.log
Maya: verified remapped ~ $16,800 to appropriate cost centers. opened ticket FIN-2027-142 for manual review of the remaining ~$1,400.
Priya: confirmed customer projects and sent reallocation approvals to legal.
Leo: closing loop — alert rule active, playbook updated, and budget owners notified. Thanks team. :rocket:
